result.rationale: Monarch is operating RNG infrastructure, but no qualifying infrastructure manager is proven. TPG's stake belongs to Rise Climate private equity; Transition Infrastructure was formed later. RAE/Smithfield are strategic owners, and TPG's unresolved exit process does not change scope.

identityResolution.boundary: JV plus nine Missouri projects; no separately manager-held project proven.
identityResolution.smithfieldMember: Smithfield subsidiary; exact legal member NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED. Public history names Smithfield Farms/Hog Production.

owners.fund: Rise Climate I (2021 vintage; legal allocation NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED)

ownershipResolution.entryMechanics: February 2022 primary issuance diluted Smithfield from 50% to 33% and gave TPG one-third; exact day, price, security and SPV were undisclosed.
ownershipResolution.governance: Three equal partners jointly control major decisions.
ownershipResolution.strategyFinding: Rise Climate I is climate private equity; 2025-vintage Transition Infrastructure is separate.

operatingResolution.footprint: Nine Missouri RNG projects on Smithfield-owned farms; 88 covered lagoons completed by 2018.
operatingResolution.assetBoundary: Monarch owns biogas facilities; Smithfield provides farms/manure/access; RAE provides technology and operations.
operatingResolution.infrastructure: Covered lagoons, gathering, upgrading/compression and ANR/Milan interconnections.
operatingResolution.markets: Transportation RNG and RFS/LCFS credits; current marketer/offtaker is NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
operatingResolution.projectTreatment: Keep all projects beneath the JV.

acquisitionExitCheck.result: 2020 $45m owner expansion; February 2022 TPG entry; Q2 2025 debt refinancing up to $61m; January 2025 sale notice. No later transfer, project sale, recap, signed buyer or exit found.
